solution: Assign weight 2^k to the letter whose alphabet offset is k; every transformation preserves total weight. Therefore, lexicographic optimality chooses the largest permitted power of two for each successive character, using powers from 2^25 (z) down to 1. Iterating downward, append the quotient copies of each power and retain the remainder; each block can be independently reduced, and induction proves maximality. The complexity is O(26n + total output length) time and O(1) auxiliary space besides the returned strings.
